/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

class Text(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.parts = []
    def handle_data(self, data):
        self.parts.append(data)

for label, headers in [
    ('provided preferences', {'Cookie': 'theme=dark', 'Accept-Language': 'fr-CA,fr;q=0.9,en;q=0.8'}),
    ('default theme', {'Accept-Language': 'en-US,en;q=0.9'}),
]:
    response = urlopen(Request('http://localhost:3100/', headers=headers))
    parser = Text()
    parser.feed(response.read().decode())
    print(label, [part for part in parser.parts if part.startswith(('Current theme:', 'Preferred language:'))])
PY"
